standards.name: IS 4985 (uPVC pipes for potable water supply)
standards.description: Bureau of Indian Standards specification for unplasticized PVC (uPVC) pipes for potable water supply. Nominal sizes ~25-630 mm; pressure classes 1-4 = PN 0.25/0.40/0.60/0.80 MPa; wall thickness based on a safe working stress of 8 MPa at 27 C. Governing standard.

standards.name: ASTM D1785 (PVC plastic pipe, Schedules 40, 80, 120)
standards.description: Dimensional/performance specification for PVC pipe in Schedules 40/80/120, nominal sizes 1/8 in to 24 in; same OD across schedules at a given size, thicker wall = higher pressure. Governing standard.

standards.name: ASTM D2241 (PVC pressure-rated pipe, SDR series)
standards.description: Specification for PVC pressure pipe by Standard Dimension Ratio (SDR 13.5, 17, 21, 26, 32.5, 41, 51, 64). Governing standard.

SDR.canonical_term: Standard Dimension Ratio = nominal outside diameter / nominal wall thickness (higher SDR = thinner wall, lower pressure)

PN.canonical_term: Nominal Pressure (French 'Pression Nominale'); the number approximates the pressure rating in bar (Pressure Class)

DN.canonical_term: Nominal Diameter (diametre nominal), metric nominal bore in mm (Nominal Diameter)

industry_references.name: Wavin U-PVC / O-PVC pressure pipe technical catalogue (manufacturer)
industry_references.description: Manufacturer technical catalogue of uPVC pressure pipe systems: dimensions, pressure classes, jointing. Manufacturer spec, not a governing standard.

industry_references.name: GF Piping Systems PVC-U metric system specification (manufacturer)
industry_references.description: Manufacturer system specification for metric PVC-U pipe, incl. SDR/PN dimensioning. Manufacturer spec, not a governing standard.
